Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/email/Document.gx"
package email

props {
  // Preview is the text that an inbox shows after the subject. It is not visible in the email.
  Preview  string = ""
  // Width is the largest width of the content in pixels.
  Width    int = 600
  // Children is the sections of the email.
  Children gx.Node
}

<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style="background-color:var(--background)">
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td align="center" style="padding:24px 12px">
        if p.Preview != "" {
          <div style="display:none;max-height:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0">{p.Preview}</div>
        }
        <table role="presentation" width={p.width()} cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" border="0" style={p.style()}>
          <tbody>
            <tr>
              <td align="left">{p.Children}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

```go title="ui/email/styles.go"
// Package email holds the parts of an HTML email: inline styles and table
// layout, which each email client reads. A component of this package has no
// class, no signal and no script (GX6010). The styles read the theme tokens
// with var(); gx.RenderEmail gives each one its value.
package email

import (
	"strconv"

	"github.com/alternayte/gx"
)

// Align is the horizontal position of the content of a part.
type Align string

// The positions of the content.
const (
	Left   Align = "left"
	Center Align = "center"
	Right  Align = "right"
)

// attr returns the value of the align attribute; a zero value is Left.
func (a Align) attr() string {
	switch a {
	case Center, Right:
		return string(a)
	}
	return string(Left)
}

// font is the font of each text. An email client has no font of the site.
const font = "font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"

// width returns the width of the content in pixels; a zero value is 600.
func (p DocumentProps) width() string {
	if p.Width <= 0 {
		return "600"
	}
	return strconv.Itoa(p.Width)
}

// style returns the style of the content table.
func (p DocumentProps) style() gx.Style {
	return gx.Style("width:100%;max-width:" + p.width() + "px")
}

// style returns the style of the cell of a section.
func (p SectionProps) style() gx.Style {
	if p.Card {
		return "padding:24px;background-color:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius)"
	}
	return "padding:12px 0"
}

// style returns the style of a column. An empty width shares the row.
func (p ColumnProps) style() gx.Style {
	s := "padding:0 8px 0 0;vertical-align:top;" + font + "font-size:16px;line-height:24px;color:var(--foreground)"
	if p.Width > 0 {
		s += ";width:" + strconv.Itoa(p.Width) + "px"
	}
	return gx.Style(s)
}

// style returns the style of a paragraph.
func (p TextProps) style() gx.Style {
	s := "margin:0 0 16px;" + font + "font-size:16px;line-height:24px;text-align:" + p.Align.attr()
	if p.Muted {
		return gx.Style(s + ";font-size:14px;line-height:20px;color:var(--muted-foreground)")
	}
	return gx.Style(s + ";color:var(--foreground)")
}

// level returns the level of a heading: 1, 2 or 3. A zero value is 1.
func (p HeadingProps) level() int {
	if p.Level < 1 {
		return 1
	}
	if p.Level > 3 {
		return 3
	}
	return p.Level
}

// style returns the style of a heading.
func (p HeadingProps) style() gx.Style {
	size := map[int]string{1: "font-size:28px;line-height:36px", 2: "font-size:22px;line-height:28px", 3: "font-size:18px;line-height:24px"}[p.level()]
	return gx.Style("margin:0 0 16px;" + font + size + ";font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground);text-align:" + p.Align.attr())
}

// size returns a pixel count as an attribute value.
func size(n int) string { return strconv.Itoa(n) }

// style returns the style of an image. The image is not wider than its
// column.
func (p ImageProps) style() gx.Style {
	return "display:block;border:0;outline:none;max-width:100%;height:auto"
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border`, `--radius`.

## Usage

The parts of an HTML email. Each part has inline styles and table layout, which each email client reads. No part has a class, a signal or a script.

Write the email as a component in a package with the name `email`. Then render it with `gx.RenderEmail`.

```gx
<email.Document preview="Your order is on its way.">
  <email.Section>
    <email.Heading>Your order is on its way</email.Heading>
    <email.Text>Thank you for your order.</email.Text>
    <email.Button href={gx.URL(route.Order{ID: p.ID}.URL())}>See the order</email.Button>
  </email.Section>
  <email.Divider />
  <email.Section card>
    <email.Row>
      <email.Column>Tea, 2 boxes</email.Column>
      <email.Column width={120} align={email.Right}>12.00</email.Column>
    </email.Row>
  </email.Section>
  <email.Image src={gx.URL("/logo.png")} alt="The logo of the shop" width={120} height={40} />
  <email.Text muted>You get this email because you have an account.</email.Text>
</email.Document>
```

```go
msg, err := gx.RenderEmail(OrderEmail(props), gx.EmailOptions{
	BaseURL: "https://shop.example",
	Tokens:  gxstyles.LightTokens(),
})
```

`msg.HTML` is the HTML document and `msg.Text` is the same content as plain text. Give the two parts to your mail library. Gx sends no email.

## Parts

| Part | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `Document` | The background and the centre column. It is the root of each email. `preview` is the text that an inbox shows after the subject. |
| `Section` | A group of parts. `card` gives it a border and padding. |
| `Row` | One row of columns. |
| `Column` | One cell of a row. `width` is in pixels; zero shares the row. |
| `Text` | A paragraph. `muted` is for a note. |
| `Heading` | A heading of `level` 1, 2 or 3. |
| `Button` | A link with the look of a button. |
| `Image` | An image with its size and its `alt` text. |
| `Divider` | A line between two sections. |

The styles read the theme tokens with `var()`: `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--border` and `--radius`. `gx.RenderEmail` gives each one the value from `gxstyles.LightTokens()` or `gxstyles.DarkTokens()`, so the email has no CSS variable.

## API reference

A tag sets a prop by its name with a lower-case first letter: `Class` is `class`.

### email.Button

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Href` | `gx.URL` | Required | Href is the address that the button opens. gx.RenderEmail makes a site path an absolute URL. |
| `Align` | `Align` | `Left` | Align is the horizontal position of the button: Left, Center or Right. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the label of the button. |

### email.Column

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Width` | `int` | `0` | Width is the width of the column in pixels. Zero shares the width of the row. |
| `Align` | `Align` | `Left` | Align is the horizontal position of the content: Left, Center or Right. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the content of the column. |

### email.Divider

The component has no props.

### email.Document

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Preview` | `string` | `""` | Preview is the text that an inbox shows after the subject. It is not visible in the email. |
| `Width` | `int` | `600` | Width is the largest width of the content in pixels. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the sections of the email. |

### email.Heading

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Level` | `int` | `1` | Level is the level of the heading: 1, 2 or 3. |
| `Align` | `Align` | `Left` | Align is the horizontal position of the heading: Left, Center or Right. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the text of the heading. |

### email.Image

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Src` | `gx.URL` | Required | Src is the address of the image. gx.RenderEmail makes a site path an absolute URL. |
| `Alt` | `string` | Required | Alt is the text of the image. An email client shows it when it blocks images. |
| `Width` | `int` | Required | Width is the width of the image in pixels. |
| `Height` | `int` | Required | Height is the height of the image in pixels. |

### email.Row

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the columns of the row. |

### email.Section

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Card` | `bool` | `false` | Card gives the section a border, a background and padding. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the content of the section. |

### email.Text

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Muted` | `bool` | `false` | Muted gives the text a smaller size and a weaker colour, for a note. |
| `Align` | `Align` | `Left` | Align is the horizontal position of the text: Left, Center or Right. |
| `Children` | `gx.Node` | Required | Children is the text. |

## Do and do not

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Put each part inside one `Document`.
- Put only `Column` parts in a `Row`.
- Give each `Image` its `alt` text, its width and its height. Many email clients block images at first.
- Use a site path or a typed link for an address. `gx.RenderEmail` makes it an absolute URL.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not add a `class` attribute or a signal to a part. The compiler reports GX6010.
- Do not use a component of a page, for example `button.Button`, in an email. Its classes have no effect there, and `gx.RenderEmail` returns an error.
- Do not put text directly in a `Row`. A table row takes only cells.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| None | The parts are static. A link and a button get the focus as each link does. |
